title: HoloGene: Learning to Lift Sliced Spatial Transcriptomics to Holistic 3D Gene Fields
abstract: arXiv:2611.20368v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Spatial transcriptomics (ST) provides spatially resolved gene expression measurements, but most 3D ST datasets are acquired as independently processed 2D sections. Computational approaches span slice registration and integration, explicit or generative interpolation, and coordinate-field modeling. Within the last family, implicit neural representations (INRs) offer a continuous, coordinate-queryable parameterization, but standard isotropic coordinate encodings do not explicitly reflect that serial-section measurements are dense in-plane and sparse along the axial direction. We present HoloGene, an anisotropic conditional INR framework for estimating continuous 3D gene-expression fields from pre-registered ST sections. Its central contribution is an acquisition-aware factorization that couples dense in-plane synthesis with sparse axial evolution using established GAE, FiLM, pseudo-label supervision, and CORAL components. translated_title: HoloGene：学习将切片空间转录组学提升为整体三维基因场
translated_abstract: 空间转录组学（ST）提供了空间分辨的基因表达测量，但大多数三维ST数据集是以独立处理的二维切片形式采集的。相关计算方法涵盖切片配准与整合、显式或生成式插值以及坐标场建模等方向。在坐标场建模这一类方法中，隐式神经表示（INR）提供了连续的、可按坐标查询的参数化方式，但标准的各向同性坐标编码并未显式反映连续切片测量在面内密集、沿轴向稀疏的采集特性。我们提出HoloGene——一个各向异性的条件INR框架，用于从预先配准的ST切片估计连续的三维基因表达场。其核心贡献是一种感知采集方式的因子分解方法，借助成熟的GAE、FiLM、伪标签监督和CORAL等组件，将密集的面内合成与稀疏的轴向演化耦合起来。HoloGene压缩……（原文在此截断）
tldr: HoloGene提出一种各向异性条件隐式神经表示框架，通过感知采集特性的因子分解，将面内密集、轴向稀疏的切片空间转录组学提升为连续的三维基因表达场。
en_tdlr: HoloGene presents an anisotropic conditional INR framework with an acquisition-aware factorization that lifts in-plane dense but axially sparse sliced spatial transcriptomics into continuous 3D gene-expression fields.
